basis: Art. 115(1): 2 months for 113(1)(1),(2); tiers 14/35/42/49/60 days for 113(1)(3),(7),(11) and 105(2); 3 days for 113(1)(12); Art. 115(1.1): 3 days for 113(1)(13); Art. 93(1): 3 days on probation. No notice period stated for fault grounds 113(1)(5),(6),(8),(9),(10).

title.ru: Не соблюдён срок предупреждения об увольнении

edge_cases: Ground-aware: the termination ground code (or the workforce-reduction flag = 113(1)(2)) selects the notice period. Skipped, never auto-resolved, while the ground is unknown.
Grounds not in the map (fault grounds 113(1)(5),(6),(8),(9),(10), 113(1)(4), others) need no notice by the Code text, so they never fire.
Service counted from first contract start with this employer; tiers by whole years of service at the notice date.
Missing notice date counts as zero days' notice.
Periods are calendar days (Art. 29(7)); a period ending on a non-working day moving to the next working day is not modelled.
Longer periods may be set by collective or labour contract (Art. 115(1)): not modelled.
Not modelled: Art. 115(2) penalty, 115(3) notice content, 115(5) lapse of notice, 115(4) time to look for work.
